children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Learn how Gameplane organizes clusters, fleet health, global search, activity, and the shortcuts you use every day.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: The dashboard, Servers, Backups and Search combine every registered cluster you can access, and an optional Location filter narrows them (since v0.3.0; v0.2.0-beta.8 used a top-bar cluster selector that scoped everything to one cluster).

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Opening a server pins it to its own cluster and namespace, so changing a list filter never retargets the server you are working on.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Narrows the dashboard, Servers and Backups to one cluster; combined view is default (v0.3.0).

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Finds any server by name across the clusters you can access.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Notifications surface failed reconciliations and completed jobs.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 3
children.text: Pick the dashboard language in Settings, saved to your account or browser (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Read the fleet at a glance

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: The home view combines live infrastructure health with product activity so you can spot drift before opening a resource.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Fleet status separates running, stopped, failed, and suspended servers.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Cluster health shows node readiness and allocatable CPU and memory; the Nodes page spans every visible cluster (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Recent activity links changes back to users and affected resources.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: A healthy workflow moves from intent to reconciliation, then closes the loop with observability and recovery.
